Code decoded at run time from the base64 zip CODE_B64 is written to /kaggle/working/lab and run as lab_entry.py subprocesses; the runner's replacement of the string '/kaggle/input' in the stage code does not reach it. The literal path /kaggle/input must therefore show exactly this stage's inputs while the stage runs: e.g. a container with the virtual input mounted at /kaggle/input (as release/docker/ff.py does; FF_LITERAL_KAGGLE=mounted), or a symlink /kaggle/input -> the virtual input on a Linux host without /kaggle (the runner makes it when this flag is set). In a Kaggle notebook whose own /kaggle/input holds other attachments, run this stage in a session with exactly its inputs attached (as the original run); the runner can only warn there (FF_LITERAL_STRICT=1 makes it an error). /kaggle/input must also hold no second copy of the files these modules look for (e.g. an original saved copy of an artifact rebuilt in the session): they take the first hit of their own scan. insert_cells.source:
print("[cell] FF dev-exclusion: train-only mode (default) - final head trained and saved, no dev list scored", flush=True)
# NEW cell of the FourFusion reproduction repository (stage CHANGES.md, type dev-exclusion). The 13.54 chain needs only the model file
# e2e_out/<TAG>_final_models.pt, which T3RECIPE-01 final() (embedded run.py lines 196-214) saves with torch.save BEFORE it scores the
# test lists of E2E_SPLIT (lines 215-224). With FF_TRAIN_ONLY unset or "1" (default) the experiment's commands run through a small
# entry that imports the embedded e2e_lib (unchanged) and makes e2e_lib.components() return {} (no test file): final() then trains,
# saves the models and writes <TAG>_final_dev.npz with no stream, and the `zip` command (dev zip; the F0 dev zip of F1) is skipped.
# Every dev read of the executed run sits in those two steps (FACELORA-03 / FACELORA-05 patch_test, CLEANTUNE-01 patch_test_cat4 act
# only inside e2e_lib.t3_split, called per test file; zip_ct reads components / check_v11_fuser / the F0 zip).
# FF_TRAIN_ONLY=0 = the executed notebook's behaviour (dev scoring + dev zip; needs the dev-list arrays, see stage.json dev_usage).
TRAIN_ONLY = os.environ.get("FF_TRAIN_ONLY", "1") != "0"
(LAB / "ff_train_only_entry.py").write_text('''"""FF dev-exclusion entry (stage CHANGES.md): python ff_train_only_entry.py <experiment> <command>
= lab_entry.py <experiment> <command> with e2e_lib.components() returning {} (no test list is scored)."""
import sys, runpy
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "Experiment" / "E2E"))
import e2e_lib
sys.path.pop(0)
e2e_lib.components = lambda: {}
sys.argv = [str(ROOT / "lab_entry.py")] + sys.argv[1:]
runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "lab_entry.py"), run_name="__main__")
''', encoding="utf-8")
log(f"FF_TRAIN_ONLY: {'on (default): no dev list is scored, no dev zip' if TRAIN_ONLY else 'off: executed behaviour (dev scoring + dev zip)'}")
